profile.company: Steve Stark's Toluca Pictures and Lilly Singh's Unicorn Island Productions
profile.belief: I always loved to write, but when I lost an entire manuscript on a hard drive in 3rd grade. It took a personal challenge to shoot an ambitious 28 minute short film (for Pride Month in 6 weeks from concept to distribution), over a decade later, for me to fall back in love with writing again. And that, I did. I graduating with an MFA in Screenwriting from UT Austin in 3 weeks!
